newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY THREE SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY THREE SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the third day of the French Open:
"I think probably his ego was a little bruised. If you take a bit of his limelight he doesn't like it." Jeff Tarango on opponent Thomas Muster.
"We know the history of Jeff. He's not an easy guy and everyone knows that. I don't think what we saw today was very professional." Muster on Tarango.
Stat of the day - The total of 10 Frenchmen involved in the second round is the most since 1983. That year Yannick Noah became the last French player to win the singles title.
Strange coincidence - Chile's Marcelo Rios, given a first round scare by Zimbabwe's Wayne Black, will now meet Byron Black, Wayne's brother, in the second round on Thursday.
